title: Measurement noise can mimic higher-order epistasis in the topography of fitness landscapes: analysis code
description: Noise-aware analysis of peaks, basins and accessibility in the GB1 (Wu et al. 2016) and folA (Papkou et al. 2023) combinatorial fitness landscapes: depth thinning, significance-thresholded reachability, low-order Fourier null models with simulated measurement noise, and a controlled degradation experiment. Raw data are downloaded and checksum-verified by fetch_data.sh; run_all.sh reproduces every result and figure.
